paper.title_en: Parameter Estimation for Eccentric Supermassive Black Hole Binaries with Pulsar Timing Arrays
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar timing array (PTA) experiments are searching for gravitational waves (GWs) in the nanohertz band. The primary GW sources targeted by PTAs include populations of inspiralling supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) in the local Universe, some of which may emit detectable continuous gravitational-wave (CGW) signals. In this paper, we focus on the detection strategy for individual binaries on eccentric orbits. Using simulated datasets based on the EPTA DR2new configuration, we perform injection-recovery studies across the parameter space. We demonstrate that individual component masses can be measured when an eccentric SMBHB is detected at high GW frequencies. We further show a correlation between the CGW signal and the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) at low frequencies, which makes CGW identification challenging. Finally, the developed software is GPU-compatible, enabling efficient Bayesian inference. This work lays the groundwork for future applications to real PTA data.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文聚焦于脉冲星计时阵列对偏心超大质量黑洞双星的参数估计，属于PTA领域的关键研究对象，与重点主题高度相关。
decision.title_zh: 基于脉冲星计时阵列的偏心超大质量黑洞双星参数估计
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）实验正在搜寻纳赫兹频段的引力波（GW）。PTA所瞄准的主要GW源包括本地宇宙中旋进的超大质量黑洞双星（SMBHBs）群体，其中一些可能发射可探测的连续引力波（CGW）信号。在本文中，我们专注于偏心轨道上单个双星的探测策略。利用基于EPTA DR2new配置的模拟数据集，我们在参数空间中进行注入-恢复研究。我们证明，当在较高GW频率上探测到偏心SMBHB时，可以测量单个分量质量。我们进一步展示了CGW信号与低频随机引力波背景（SGWB）之间的相关性，这使得CGW识别具有挑战性。最后，所开发的软件支持GPU，能够实现高效的贝叶斯推断。这项工作为未来应用于真实PTA数据奠定了基础。
